item.title: Permission, Planning, and Courage, A Christ-Centered Look at Nehemiah 2
item.description: In Nehemiah 2, we see God's provision, timing, and sovereign hand as Nehemiah receives permission to rebuild, plans wisely, and leads with courage. This devotional explores how prayer, faith, and obedience guide us as we rise up and build.

item.title: Why the Deity of Christ Matters for the Christian Worldview
item.description: In this episode of Equipping You in Grace, Dave Jenkins explains why the deity of Christ is essential to the gospel and the Christian worldview, addressing Scripture, church history, modern skepticism, and why only God can save.
